title: The version of the app moves from About to the bottom of the Menu
why: Coach Milan 20 November 10:19: the version is one more tap away, in About, and not in the best place; put it in the Menu, between the menu block and Sign out.

opportunity.job: As a tester or Coach Milan, see which version I run at a glance, when I report something or check a release.
opportunity.kind: Slow: the version sits inside About, one tap further.
opportunity.why_now: Releases come several a day, and testers report against a version.

problem: To see which version runs, I open the Menu, scroll to About and open it. The version is the last line there.
story: When I open the Menu, I want to see the version at its bottom, so that I know which release I am on without one more tap, and find it in one place only.

ac.title: In the Menu
ac.text: Given the Menu, when I scroll to its bottom, then the line under Who's behind it · Impressum · Privacy notice · Disclaimer says Version, the number and the commit.

ac.title: Above Sign out
ac.text: Given I am signed in, when I see the bottom of the Menu, then the version line sits between the links and Sign out.

ac.title: The release it is
ac.text: Given the app of a release, when I read the version line, then it is that release's number and commit.

ac.title: Not in About any more
ac.text: Given About, when I open it, then the version line is not there: About ends with the links line, and the version is only in the Menu.

unchanged: About's other lines: the name, what the app does, the data note, the email and the links.
The links line and Sign out in the Menu.
short: The version line moves from About to the bottom of the Menu
rel: Redrawn; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: DT331: the version of the app moves from About to the bottom of the Menu
now: The version is the last line of About, one tap away from the Menu.
proposed: The line Version and the number · the commit moves to the bottom of the Menu, under the links, above Sign out. About has it no more.
decision: Go 20 November 10:43; built in 0.3.168 with the line in the Menu and in About. Redrawn 20 November 11:01 on Coach Milan's word: the line moves, so About drops it. Waits for Go.
details: The pictures are the real app, all from one scratch build of 0.3.167, not committed, built with the commit as the live app shows it (d1b274d). A local run has no sign-in, so the scratch shows Sign out as a signed-in phone has it.
Preview and production look the same: both show the release number and its commit.
The line in small muted text, as the links above it.
0.3.168 has the line in both places; this change takes it out of About.
